Professional fashion photograph, waist-up portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to just below the navel, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

An Austrian woman, mid 20s, with an extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, her waist lost beneath the folds. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, and a sweet pudding-bakery heroine look brought to life, with glossy golden-caramel hair in a high ponytail with soft curled ends and a cream ribbon bow. Her complexion is a fair porcelain with a light dusting of freckles, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in honey-brown contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long curled lashes, a soft caramel and cream shimmer on the lids and a thin soft liner, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small and glossy, in a peach gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a happy smile. A deep warm-pink blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A cheerful, bright, wide-eyed gaze. Jewelry: gold pearl drop earrings with a gold ear cuff chain and a thin gold necklace with a tiny whisk charm. Pose: head tilted, one hand lightly touching her ponytail.

Background: a softly blurred bakery with warm cream and pink bokeh.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of her frame.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
